top_left.description: A female wasp carefully constructing a small mud-cell nest inside a crevice of Maroon-colored mudstone; using her mandibles to smooth the 'Chalky white' clay.
top_left.educational_note: Demonstrates early nesting and maternal care behaviors.

top_right.description: The wasp capturing a small beetle larva among Paleopus herbs; the scene is framed to look like a 'heroic' catch rather than a scary hunt.
top_right.educational_note: Explains the predatory role of wasps in controlling other insect populations.

bottom_left.description: The wasp tucked under a broad leaf of an early angiosperm during a rain shower; water droplets are stylized and large, reflecting the 'Dappled' light.
bottom_left.educational_note: Shows how insects seek protection from the elements.

bottom_right.description: Two wasps performing a synchronized hovering 'dance' near a Conifer branch, showing dynamic posing and expressive facial features.
bottom_right.educational_note: Visualizes social communication or territorial displays in a friendly way.

visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC with warm highlights and soft-edged shadows.
